A. Kathy takes the condominium by right of survivorship as estate by entirety property, which passes outside the will and is unaffected by the prenuptial agreement; Tommy takes the pasture land under the will, and Tommy and Julie split the residue. The prenuptial waiver does not create a pretermitted-spouse claim here because the condominium passed by survivorship, not through the will.
CONFIDENCE: 95
